title: Mars Climate Orbiter Mishap Investigation Board Phase I Report
summary: NASA mishap board Phase I report for the loss of Mars Climate Orbiter; used as the primary source for the first promoted MCO engineering-failure record.

source_payload.author_or_body: Mars Climate Orbiter Mishap Investigation Board / NASA
source_payload.copyability: not embedded in this revision; linked and line-located only
extraction_notes: The report identifies the root cause as failure to use metric units in a ground software file used in trajectory models.
The source gives the unit mismatch in Newton-seconds versus pound-force-seconds and states that processing underestimated the thruster-firing effect by a factor of 4.45.
The source also records contributing factors around early AMD file problems, anomalous data, limited observability, operations-team familiarity, and non-execution of TCM-5.

handling_notes: Mission-loss case; no personal blame tokenization.
Treat official-board root cause as source-specific language, not omniscient explanation.
